question: Should explicit effective `toolsAllow: []` be a deliberate no-tools override for inherited non-enforcing allowlists, while only `enforceWhenToolsDisabled` sources remain fail-closed?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and tested, but it intentionally changes the compatibility and policy meaning of an inherited allowlist at an agent tool-execution boundary.

options.title: Confirm explicit no-tools semantics
options.body: Accept the proposed contract: explicit `toolsAllow: []` reaches the model with zero tools while explicitly enforcing runtime restrictions still block unresolved tool requests.

options.title: Preserve inherited failure behavior
options.body: Keep inherited allowlists as a pre-model failure condition for explicit empty Automation allowlists and close or redesign this PR with a different product contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm explicit no-tools semantics
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed contract: explicit `toolsAllow: []` reaches the model with zero tools while explicitly enforcing runtime restrictions still block unresolved tool requests.
